items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: Was it Kirk? Was that the band -- ... Yeah. But I think he must have been with Kirk you know.

ctx.x: I guess you didn't -- when you were in Kansas City, Bart hadn't commenced --
No, he hadn't. He was with what band? I don't remember. Was it Kirk? Was that the band --
He was with Jay McShann, but that was later --
